Suman Kumar Sharma @ Suman Kumar vs The State Of
Jharkhand ...

Opposite ... on 13 June, 2024
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 B.A. No.4427 of 2024
 Suman Kumar Sharma @ Suman Kumar
 ... Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ... Opposite Party

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
For the Petitioner : Mr. K.K. Mishra, Adv.

For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, Addl. P.P. Order No.04/Dated- 13.06.2024 Heard learned counsel
for the parties.

2.  The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Giridih (Cyber) P.S. Case No. 06 of 2023 registered under Sections 467/468/471/419/420/413/414/120(B)/34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 66(B)/66(C)/66(D) of the Information Technology Act.

3. As per F.I.R., the allegation against the petitioner is that on 06.03.2023, informant got secret information for commission of cybercrime and apprehended co-accused Nikhil Kumar along with his accomplices for committing cybercrime.
Police recovered cash, mobile phones and evidence of fraudulent activities, including fake bank messages and large money transfers, revealing a network involved in extensive cyber fraud.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case only on the basis of suspicion.

It is further submitted that with similar allegation three other co-accused persons namely Nikhil Kumar, Jakir Hussain @ Jakir Ansari and Mohan Saw have been granted regular bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in B.A. Nos. 4909 of 2023, 5292 of 2023 and 10322 of 2023 vide orders dated 02.06.2023, 11.07.2023 and 09.11.2023 respectively.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 06.02.2024 without any rhymes and reasons.
Hence the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5. Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may not be enlarged on bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record and period of custody of the petitioner, I am inclined to release the above named petitioner, on bail.
Accordingly, the petitioner named above, is directed to Suman Kumar Sharma @ Suman Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
